speaker: john_heminges
text: The reckoning stands thus. Doors open, the ordinary costs out before anyone is witty. Your share, Will, forty shillings.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Forty. Say it once, John. I am not here for a speech about a good week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forty shillings. Last Saturday was eight-and-twenty. I have both.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Forty is a better week than eight-and-twenty. I will take it. I will not average them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Forty. The spring has not given me a better. I am not asking why.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Forty, and the same forty as the rest. I danced, and the share does not grow a second head for the dancing.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The share is the pay. I start a sentence once. Forty shillings. Last Saturday eight-and-twenty. This is the spring's best, and it is still a share.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Best is a word. Forty is the coin. I will take the coin.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The doors opened. That is as much cause as I mean to give a good week. Nobody is to spend this sheet on the lease.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lease is not in this room. Nothing was agreed on Monday. I am not agreeing it now.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the sheet is the share, not the lease. No timber. No clause. No curse. Forty shillings, and the book shuts on that.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Shut it. I have heard four-and-twenty pound and fourteen too often for one week, and neither of them is today's coin.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good. A landlord is a dull jig. Forty shillings is a short one, and I can leave on it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Leave, then. The boys are not a column on this sheet. I am not opening one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: There is no such column. Will, forty. Say it back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forty shillings. Eight-and-twenty last Saturday. The chest is not counted. The share is the share.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The house stood. The share is forty. I am not making it longer, and I am not pricing a beam.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A beam can wait. My supper will not. Forty, and I am gone when John shuts the book.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Shut it before someone remembers a slipper. I am paid. I am pleasant. It will not last.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut. Forty. Nothing of Allen on this sheet.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nothing of Allen. The sentence is finished. Forty shillings, the spring's best, and the book is shut.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Shut. I am for home.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And I. I am not carrying a reckoning into a song.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Home, then. The doors next week as they were.

speaker: george_bryan
text: As they were. I have forty shillings and no new opinion.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. Forty. I am going home to supper, and then to the page.
